# A spatial multi-omic portrait of survival outcome for clear cell renal cell carcinoma, Meyer et al., 2026

**DISCLAIMER**: The study is currently undergoing peer-review. Therefore, the code base is under active development. It includes code for all data presented in the manuscript but also exploratory data analysis parts. File paths have to be adjusted by the user.

# Single-cell analysis - Myeloid classification

Here, we will perform the spatial single cell analysis steps for the myeloid panel. 

## Load data

```{r load data, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
#sce with all cells
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_04.rds") 
sce

#TME sce
sce_TME <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_immune_05.rds") 
sce_TME

#Myeloid sce
sce_MY <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_06.rds")
sce_MY
```

## 1. Data integration

```{r}
# New information from TME sce 
colnames(colData(sce_TME))[!colnames(colData(sce_TME)) %in% colnames(colData(sce))]
## To transfer: astir_immune_combined, GMM_immune_combined, cluster_selected, immune_metacluster

# New information from myeloid sce 
colnames(colData(sce_MY))[!colnames(colData(sce_MY)) %in% colnames(colData(sce_TME))]
## To transfer: my_cluster_selected, astir_myeloid_type, myeloid_metacluster, my_cluster_names
```

## Combine myeloid and TME cluster/metacluster/color information

```{r combine tumor TME, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
## 1. Cell type information 
### 1. TME
TME_info <- colData(sce_TME) %>% as.data.frame %>% mutate(immune_cluster_selected = paste0("immune_",sce_TME$cluster_selected)) %>% select(cell_id, astir_immune_combined, GMM_immune_combined, immune_cluster_selected, immune_metacluster)

### 2. MY
MY_info <- colData(sce_MY) %>% as.data.frame %>% 
  mutate(myeloid_metacluster = paste0("MY_",sce_MY$myeloid_metacluster), 
         my_cluster_selected = paste0("MY_",sce_MY$my_cluster_selected),
         my_cluster_names = paste0("MY_",sce_MY$my_cluster_names),
         myeloid_district = paste0("MY_",sce_MY$myeloid_district),
         myeloid_district_names = paste0("MY_",sce_MY$myeloid_district_names)) %>% 
  select(cell_id, my_cluster_selected, astir_myeloid_type, myeloid_metacluster, my_cluster_names, myeloid_district, myeloid_district_names)

### Add to sce
sce$astir_immune_combined <- TME_info$astir_immune_combined[match(sce$cell_id, TME_info$cell_id)]
sce$GMM_immune_combined <- TME_info$GMM_immune_combined[match(sce$cell_id, TME_info$cell_id)]
sce$immune_cluster_selected <- TME_info$immune_cluster_selected[match(sce$cell_id, TME_info$cell_id)]
sce$immune_metacluster <- TME_info$immune_metacluster[match(sce$cell_id, TME_info$cell_id)]

sce$my_cluster_selected <- MY_info$my_cluster_selected[match(sce$cell_id, MY_info$cell_id)]
sce$astir_myeloid_type <- MY_info$astir_myeloid_type[match(sce$cell_id, MY_info$cell_id)]
sce$myeloid_metacluster <- MY_info$myeloid_metacluster[match(sce$cell_id, MY_info$cell_id)]
sce$my_cluster_names <- MY_info$my_cluster_names[match(sce$cell_id, MY_info$cell_id)]
sce$myeloid_district <- MY_info$myeloid_district[match(sce$cell_id, MY_info$cell_id)]
sce$myeloid_district_names <- MY_info$myeloid_district_names[match(sce$cell_id, MY_info$cell_id)]

## 2. Color mapping
metadata(sce)$colors$immune_metacluster <- metadata(sce_TME)$colors$immune_metacluster
metadata(sce)$colors$myeloid_metacluster <- metadata(sce_MY)$colors$myeloid_metacluster

names(metadata(sce)$colors$myeloid_metacluster) <- paste0("MY_", names(metadata(sce)$colors$myeloid_metacluster))

## 3. Cluster channels 
rowData(sce)$immune_cluster_channel <- rowData(sce_TME)$sub_cluster
rowData(sce)$MY_cluster_channel <- rowData(sce_MY)$myeloid_cluster_1
```


```{r}
## Create combined cell type category 
sce$celltype_combined <- ifelse(!is.na(sce$myeloid_metacluster), sce$myeloid_metacluster,
       ifelse(!is.na(sce$immune_metacluster), unfactor(sce$immune_metacluster), sce$analysis_cat))

sce$celltype_combined_fine <- ifelse(!is.na(sce$my_cluster_names), sce$my_cluster_names,
       ifelse(!is.na(sce$immune_metacluster), unfactor(sce$immune_metacluster), sce$analysis_cat))

unique(sce$celltype_combined)
unique(sce$celltype_combined_fine)
```


```{r save_objects, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Save sce
saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_07.rds")
```


## Heatmap visualization 

```{r}
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_07.rds")

sce$celltype_combined_broad <- ifelse(str_detect(sce$celltype_combined, "MY"), unfactor(sce$immune_metacluster), sce$celltype_combined)

sce$astir_combined_broad <- ifelse(!is.na(sce$astir_immune_combined), sce$astir_immune_combined,
       ifelse(!is.na(sce$astir_combined), sce$astir_combined, NA))
```

```{r}
#Read sce after clustering, astir and G

### 1. Heatmap body ###

# Aggregrate across cells with the mean
mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$celltype_combined_broad,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "exprs",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce)$broad_cluster)

# Heatmap body color 
col_main = viridis(100)

### 2. Heatmap annotation ###

### 2.1 Spatial features

#Select spatial features and average over celltype_combined_broads 
spatial <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(area,eccentricity,n_neighbors, celltype_combined_broad)
spatial <- spatial %>% select(-celltype_combined_broad) %>% aggregate(by = list(celltype_combined_broad = spatial$celltype_combined_broad), FUN = mean) %>% column_to_rownames("celltype_combined_broad")

#Define color schemes for spatial features and add to metadata
area_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$area),median(spatial$area),max(spatial$area)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$area <- area_col

eccentricity_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$eccentricity),median(spatial$eccentricity),max(spatial$eccentricity)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$eccentricity <- eccentricity_col

n_neighbors_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$n_neighbors),median(spatial$n_neighbors),max(spatial$n_neighbors)), c(brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[1],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[2],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$n_neighbors <- n_neighbors_col

#Create Spatial Heatmap Annotation
ha_spatial <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    area = spatial$area,
    eccentricity = spatial$eccentricity,
    n_neighbors = spatial$n_neighbors, 
    col = list(area = metadata(sce)$colors$area,
               eccentricity = metadata(sce)$colors$eccentricity,
               n_neighbors = metadata(sce)$colors$n_neighbors),
    border = TRUE,
    which = "row")

### 2.2 Astir prediction 

# Astir cell types per cluster
astir_anno <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(celltype_combined_broad,astir_combined_broad) %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
astir_anno <- astir_anno %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
astir_anno <- astir_anno %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = celltype_combined_broad,names_from = astir_combined_broad,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("celltype_combined_broad")

## GMM cell types per cluster
GMM_anno <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(celltype_combined_broad,GMM_immune_combined) %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
GMM_anno <- GMM_anno %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
GMM_anno <- GMM_anno %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = celltype_combined_broad,names_from = GMM_immune_combined,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("celltype_combined_broad")

# ha_astir_GMM <- HeatmapAnnotation(
#   astir_combined_broad = anno_barplot(astir_anno, width = unit(20, "mm"), gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$astir_col)),
#   GMM_immune_combined = anno_barplot(GMM_anno, width = unit(20, "mm"), gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$GMM_col)),
#                             border = TRUE,
#                             annotation_name_rot = 90,
#                             gap = unit(3,"mm"),
#                             which = "row")

### 2.3 Metadata features

#Number of cells per celltype_combined_broad 
n_cells <- colData(mean_sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(celltype_combined_broad, ncells)

# # Number of contributing patients (at least 5 cells)
cluster_PID <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(celltype_combined_broad,PID) %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
n_PID <- cluster_PID %>% filter(Freq>5) %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% count(name = "n_PID") %>% column_to_rownames("celltype_combined_broad")

# Proportion of ISUP_combined grade per cluster
ISUP_combined <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(celltype_combined_broad,ISUP_combined) %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
ISUP_combined <- ISUP_combined %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
ISUP_combined <- ISUP_combined %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = celltype_combined_broad,names_from = ISUP_combined,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("celltype_combined_broad")

# Proportion of pT stage per cluster
pT <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(celltype_combined_broad,pT_combined) %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
pT <- pT %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
pT <- pT %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = celltype_combined_broad,names_from = pT_combined,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("celltype_combined_broad")

# Proportion of necrose per cluster
necrose <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(celltype_combined_broad,necrose) %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
necrose <- necrose %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
necrose <- necrose %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = celltype_combined_broad,names_from = necrose,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("celltype_combined_broad")

PDL1_score <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(celltype_combined_broad,PDL1_score) %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PDL1_score <- PDL1_score %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
PDL1_score <- PDL1_score %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = celltype_combined_broad,names_from = PDL1_score,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("celltype_combined_broad")


ha_meta <- HeatmapAnnotation(ISUP_combined = anno_barplot(ISUP_combined, width = unit(12, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$ISUP_combined)),
                              pT_combined = anno_barplot(pT, width = unit(12, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$pT_combined)),
                            necrose = anno_barplot(necrose, width = unit(12, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$necrose)),
                            PDL1_score = anno_barplot(PDL1_score, width = unit(12, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$PDL1_score)),
                            n_cells = anno_barplot(n_cells$ncells, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF", col = 1)),                        n_PID = anno_barplot(n_PID$n_PID, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF", col = 1)),

                            border = TRUE, 
                            annotation_name_rot = 90,
                            gap = unit(1,"mm"),
                            which = "row")


### 3. Annotation dataframe

anno <- colData(mean_sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(celltype_combined_broad, ncells)

### 4. Plot combined Heatmap
h <- Heatmap(t(assay(mean_sce, "exprs")),
        col = col_main,
        name = "exprs",
        show_row_names = T, 
        row_names_side = "left",
        show_column_names =  T, 
        #row_split = anno$immune_cat,
        cluster_row_slices = FALSE,
        row_title = NULL,
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
        clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2"
        )+
  Heatmap(scale(t(assay(mean_sce, "exprs"))))#+
  #ha_astir_GMM+
  #ha_spatial+
  #ha_meta

# Create legends for annotation 
#lgd <- Legend(title = "Immune metacluster", at = names(metadata(sce)$colors$celltype_combined_broad), 
              #legend_gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$celltype_combined_broad))

# Draw heatmap
draw(h)
#draw(h, annotation_legend_list = list(lgd))
```
